_about: Music share rules used by build_combined.py (see docs/patch/v4-design.md to v6-design.md). Shares are fractions of the MUSIC picks in a music type; 'pause.share' is the fraction of all picks that are short silences.
_periods: Clock periods for the time-gated copies. Must cover 24 h once. Night (Nyghtfall leads) is 20-06 = A+B.
_pause: Pauses: wherever a list had silences, they are replaced by vanilla's 10-second silence (_MUSExploreSILENT10, allowed at all hours) at 5% of picks. Longer silences are left out.
_vanilla_leftover: Vanilla tracks LORKHAN doesn't replace form the group 'Vanilla' with a token 2%.
_vanilla_group: Vanilla track records whose music file LORKHAN - Soundtrack Replacer replaces (listed in lorkhan_files.txt). An equal partner in the default class, 10% elsewhere.
_vanilla_peer_classes: In these classes LORKHAN is an equal partner of Chapter II, Celtic and Still instead of a fixed 10% share.
